title: Flow editor
subtitle: Arrange a scenario into compilable steps: valid flows compile to pytest, then save and use the existing run and evidence path.
insertAfterSelected: New nodes are inserted after the selected node.
appendToEnd: With no selection, new nodes are appended.
selectNode: Select a node to edit its properties.
previewPending: The preview appears once the flow is valid.
errorEmpty: A flow needs at least one node.
errorStartNavigate: The first node must be Navigate.
errorValueRequired: {{label}}: needs a value or an environment variable.
errorValueOrEnv: {{label}}: use either a value or an environment variable.
errorBranchesOnlyOnCondition: {{label}}: only condition nodes may carry branches.
warnEmptyBranches: {{label}}: both branches are empty; the compiled step will be skipped.
